title: How a hand warmer heats up by rusting
group: HOWN — How and Why in Nature
examples: Why does a hand warmer get hot?
How do click hand warmers work?

explain.say: A disposable hand warmer is a little bag of iron powder, salt, water and charcoal, sealed in an airtight wrapper.

draw.text: How a hand warmer heats up by rusting

explain.say: Open the wrapper and air gets in. The iron starts to rust, and rusting is exothermic, which means it gives out heat.
A nail rusts too slowly to feel warm, but the fine powder has a huge surface, and the salt speeds things up, so the bag stays warm for hours.
When all the iron has turned to iron oxide, the reaction stops and the warmer cools down. It cannot be reused.

faq.q: What is inside a hand warmer?
faq.a: Iron powder, salt, a little water held in a material like vermiculite, and activated charcoal, all in a bag that lets air in slowly.
asks: What are hand warmers made of?

faq.q: Why does rusting give out heat?
faq.a: When iron joins with oxygen to make iron oxide, the new bonds hold less energy than the old ones, and the difference is released as heat. Reactions like this are exothermic.

faq.q: Why does a hand warmer rust so much faster than a nail?
faq.a: The iron is a fine powder with an enormous surface, salt speeds the reaction, and the charcoal holds water and air close to the iron.
asks: Why doesn't a rusty nail feel warm?

faq.q: How do click hand warmers work?
faq.a: They hold a supersaturated solution of sodium acetate. Clicking a metal disc starts it crystallising, which gives out heat. Boiling the pack dissolves the crystals so it can be reused.
asks: How do reusable hand warmers work?

faq.q: Why can't you reuse an iron hand warmer?
faq.a: Once the iron has turned into iron oxide, there is no fresh iron left to react, so no more heat can be made.
asks: Can you recharge a hand warmer?

facts: Air-activated hand warmers can stay warm for up to around 10 hours.
Click-type hand warmers use sodium acetate, which gives out heat as it crystallises, reaching about 54 degrees Celsius.
